caption: The image depicts a wooden signboard that has a rectangular central panel framed by a thicker, paler wooden border, with two twisted vertical rods on either side that extend above the top edge. The central panel is brownish-red and features a drawing of a tree in the upper section, with some portions of the surface worn away, revealing lighter patches beneath. Below the tree is carved text stating "Entertainment For Man & Hors." Near the bottom of the wooden border, the year "1768" is inscribed. The wood of the frame appears aged and weathered, showing a mix of light gray and faded brown hues. The background of the image is a plain, light color without any additional objects or patterns.
title: Tavern Sign
